name: list_dir
description: List files/dirs in the sandbox. Read-only.

path.description: Dir to list, relative to sandbox root.

name: read_file
description: Read a text file. Read-only. Default: compact OUTLINE (md headings / ts top-level signatures / json+yaml key paths), not the full file. Use 'symbol' for one part, 'full:true' for everything. Call tool_help('read_file') before relying on 'symbol' or 'full' for the first time.

path.description: Path to the file, relative to sandbox root.

full.description: Whole file, no outline. >4KB outlineable files need 'reason' too.

reason.description: Why you need 'full' on a large outlineable file. See tool_help.

symbol.description: Fetch one part instead of the full outline: heading/symbol/key-path.

name: file_stat
description: Size/type/mtime of a file or dir. Read-only.

name: search_files
description: Search file CONTENT (not names — use find_files for that) via ripgrep. Read-only. Good for finding where something is defined/used.

query.description: Text or regex to find in file content.

path.description: Dir/file to search within, relative to sandbox root.

regex.description: Treat query as regex (default: literal text).

name: find_files
description: Find files by NAME/PATH (not content — use search_files for content) via ripgrep --files. Read-only.

pattern.description: Glob or substring to match FILE NAME/PATH (not content), e.g. '*.ts', 'invite'.

path.description: Dir to search within, relative to sandbox root.

name: write_file
description: Create a file, or overwrite one's ENTIRE content. For partial edits of an existing file use edit_file instead. Call tool_help('write_file') before overwriting a file you haven't fully read.

path.description: Path to write, relative to sandbox root.

name: edit_file
description: Targeted search-and-replace edit (oldString -> newString) without sending the whole file. PREFERRED over write_file for partial changes. oldString must match exactly once (or pass replaceAll). Not sure of exact current text? read_file first.

path.description: Path to an EXISTING file, relative to sandbox root.

oldString.description: Exact text to replace; must match exactly once unless replaceAll.

replaceAll.description: Replace all matches instead of requiring exactly one.

name: tool_help
description: Full usage guide for one tool (edge cases, multi-step workflow, the 'why' behind a constraint). Call this before the first tricky use of read_file, edit_file, write_file, find_files, search_files or web_fetch — their one-line descriptions are intentionally terse.

name: web_fetch
description: Fetch a URL (GET only, read-only). HTML -> markdown, default OUTLINE (headings only). Use 'section' for one part, 'full'/'raw' for more. SPAs auto-render via headless browser if needed. Call tool_help('web_fetch') before first use.

full.description: Full converted page instead of outline. Ignored if raw.

section.description: One heading section only (substring match), markdown or raw HTML.

raw.description: Unconverted response body instead of markdown. See tool_help first.

render.description: JS rendering for SPAs: auto=render only if needed, always=force, never=static only.

parameters.name: web_search
parameters.description: Web search -> list of {title, url, snippet}. Read-only, no API key. Follow up with web_fetch.
